title: The Bernoulli scheme and its approximations

steps.title: Bernoulli formula
steps.idea: n independent trials, each a success with probability p: the number of successes follows the binomial law.
formula: Pₙ(k) = Cₙᵏ pᵏ qⁿ⁻ᵏ,  q = 1 − p

steps.title: Local de Moivre–Laplace theorem
steps.idea: For large n the binomial probabilities follow the normal bell.

steps.title: Integral theorem
steps.idea: The probability that the count falls in a range is an area under the normal curve.
steps.example: n = 5000, p = 0.01, P(0 ≤ k ≤ 50): exact 0.5375, normal 0.5. The continuity correction closes most of the gap.

steps.title: Poisson approximation
steps.idea: When p is small and np = λ is moderate, rare events follow the Poisson law.
formula: Pₙ(k) ≈ λᵏ e^(−λ) / k!,  λ = np
